title: Ink Calligraphy Illustration
coreRelationships: The ornate 'INK' typography is the central focus, visually connected to the hand and quill pen.
The script text frames the ornate 'INK', providing context and a sense of flow.
Ink splatters act as dynamic accents, suggesting movement and the raw material of the art.
The hand and quill pen are positioned to imply the creation of the 'INK' typography.
The textured background provides a subtle, tactile foundation for the ink elements.
reuseFormula: Recreate the central 'INK' typography as an ornate, illustrative design, ensuring a hand with a quill pen is depicted actively creating or interacting with it. Frame this central element with elegant script text. Use a textured, light background and accent with black ink splatters and a single, desaturated accent color wash. Maintain a classic, hand-drawn aesthetic.
